memhotCurrentGap.observed: Each discovery call fetches at most three custom feeds, selected by a UTC-day rotation. This is not independent continuous collection of every subscribed source.
memhotCurrentGap.impact: Adding more sources alone does not guarantee timely coverage; repeated requests on the same day select the same subset.

proposedCollectionArchitecture.shared: Verified public sources may share collection and permitted content storage; subscription and reading state remain per user.
proposedCollectionArchitecture.private: Credentialed feeds, forwarded newsletters, private reader contents and personal research stay tenant-scoped. Do not infer public visibility merely from an unauthenticated URL; bearer tokens may be embedded in URLs.
proposedCollectionArchitecture.cost: Routine scheduled HTTP collection does not require a model. Pi consumes the indexed materials and searches for gaps with a per-job budget.
proposedCollectionArchitecture.freeAndPaid: The free baseline includes curated public sources, citations and user feed imports. Paid upgrades can fund deeper research, higher frequency and licensed data; freshness and factual-quality requirements remain the same.

werss.scope: User-owned dedicated instance only until isolation is independently established.
werss.notes: Existing key permission strings do not establish enforced read-only or cross-user isolation. Keep WeChat sessions outside Memhot and restrict connector read paths.
